extension.summary: Song lyrics from your Jellyfin server
extension.description: Shows lyrics from a Jellyfin server, either in a window drawn by this add-on or handed to a skin.
extension.news: v0.3.1 • Fixed lyrics stuck on the top row and scrolling in jumps on Kodi 22 • Fixed untimed lyrics opening mid-song • Fixed the sung line jumping to the top after seeking back • Fixed the lyrics window starting on the first line when opened mid-song • Fixed the first arrow press in the lyrics window not scrolling • Fixed scrolling by hand running past the end of the lyrics • Fixed the sung line sitting high in skins that don't resize their overlay • Fixed Kodi freezing if the add-on was updated or disabled with its window open • Added machine translations for 26 languages, pending review by native speakers • Removed the debug logging setting; use Kodi's debug logging instead • Relicensed under GPL v2 or later
